violations.text: The establishment does not have an allergen statement present for consumer awareness. A sign, placard, or statement on the menus must say "PLEASE INFORM US OF ANY ALLERGIES". PIc informed. New Violation. Correct By: 10/29/2026

The establishment does not employ a full-time, on-site manager certified in food safety at all times when time temperature control for safety (TCS) food is being prepared, handled, and/or served. New Violation. Correct By: 10/29/2026

(Chicken wings and cheese) was observed held at (46) degrees Fahrenheit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling.PIC voluntarily disposed of food product. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 10/29/2026

(Sausage ) was observed thawing in 3 bay sink. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods must be thawed in one of the following manners: under refrigeration (41 degrees Fahrenheit or less); completely submerged under running water; as part of the cooking process; or in the microwave if cooked immediately after thawing. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 10/29/2026

Staff were observed not wearing hair restraints. Food employees must wear hair restraints such as hats, hair coverings, or nets that are worn to effectively keep their hair from contacting exposed food, clean equipment/utensils, linens, and unwrapped single-service and single-use articles. New Violation. Correct By: 10/29/2026
Knives was observed being stored in food storage shelves opening.Moved to 3 bay sink for washing and sanitizing. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 10/29/2026

(Walk in cooler and prep unit ) located in the (kitchen area ) area was not in good repair.Ambient temperatures observed at 46DF. PIC adjusted temperature during inspection. Walk in cooler observed at 40DF. Prep unit observed at 43DF. Pic to continue to monitor temperatures of both units. Door handle to 1 dr reach(basement) is in poor repair. Observed a broken door handle. New Violation. Correct By: 10/29/2026

The following non-food contact surfaces have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris: -bakers racks -floor mixer base -counter dough roller base -prep table shelves -shelves above 3 bay sink. New Violation. Correct By: 10/29/2026
The door to the (kitchen ) toilet room is not self-closing. New Violation. Correct By: 10/29/2026

The floors throughout the facility including basement have an accumulation of soil residue and/or food debris. The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. New Violation. Correct By: 10/29/2026

Unnecessary and/or non-functional equipment or items were observed in the (basement) area. Establishments shall be kept free of unnecessary and/or non-functional equipment and litter to prevent harborage conditions. New Violation. Correct By: 11/19/2026

Food contact surfaces of equipment/utensils (can opener, slicer, knives) were observed with an accumulation of food and debris. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. New Violation. Correct By: 10/09/2024
Working containers used for storing chemicals taken from bulk supplies were not marked with the common name of the chemical. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 10/09/2024

Staff were observed not wearing hair restraints. Food employees must wear hair restraints such as hats, hair coverings, or nets that are worn to effectively keep their hair from contacting exposed food, clean equipment/utensils, linens, and unwrapped single-service and single-use articles. New Violation. Correct By: 10/09/2024
The gasket on the larger food prep unit was not in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 10/23/2024

The non-food contact surfaces of the following have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris: floor mixer can opener base prep units, especially beneath the lids and around hardware New Violation. Correct By: 10/09/2024
The door to the toilet room is not self-closing. New Violation. Correct By: 10/23/2024

The dumpster area has an accumulation of litter, leaf litter, and debris. The adjacent area behind a storage trailer has an accumulation of unused items, trash, and litter. The area must be maintained clean. New Violation. Correct By: 10/23/2024
Cobwebs observed above the clean towel storage area in basement. The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. New Violation. Correct By: 10/09/2024
Two lights beneath the hood were nonfunctional during inspection. The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 10/19/2024
The floor in the kitchen is in poor repair, with numerous cracked tiles. The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 10/09/2025

Employees' clothing or other personal belongings were observed stored on a shelf in the dry storage area. Lockers or other suitable facilities shall be used for the orderly storage of employees' clothing and other possessions. New Violation. Correct By: 10/09/2024
